##### Project general facts

Al Naseem is a beautifully conceived villa community by Modon, created to deliver some of the finest family homes available today. The collection offers four, five and six-bedroom villas, each set within generous private boundaries and designed so that indoor and outdoor living blend seamlessly together. Buyers can choose between two distinctive frontages, the South Californian style with its sloped roof and warm natural timber detailing, or the Modern Contemporary style with dark grey metal cornices, white stucco walls and full-height glazing.

Residents enjoy an exceptional range of amenities built right into the community, including a country club with a gym, spa and swimming pool. The neighbourhood is thoughtfully arranged around schools, parks, a mosque and accessible retail, all served by a gated entrance for complete peace of mind. Pedestrian paths and dedicated cycle routes weave throughout, while each villa comes with its own pool, private garden and vast terraces for relaxing and entertaining.

Inside, the villas are finished in soft neutral colours that create an immediate sense of calm and space. Bespoke oak veneer furniture, earthy travertine porcelain tiles, whitewashed paint and brushed gold metal detailing come together to give every room a refined, tactile warmth. Multiple living spaces flow from a welcoming majlis to family dining and lounge areas, opening onto a central courtyard, while show kitchens, elegant master suites, walk-in closets and sculptural bathrooms complete a home built for generations to come.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Hudayriyat Island, this exceptional location is a destination shaped by duality — where energy and calm, urbanity and sanctuary, discovery and accessibility exist in seamless balance. Set against pristine waters and open skies, the island brings together leisure, sport, wellness, and community in one iconic setting, designed for life to move in a natural state of flow.

The location is distinguished by its effortless connectivity and world-class surroundings. Zayed International Airport, Abu Dhabi Global Market, the Louvre Museum, and Yas Island’s attractions are all within a short drive. The island itself offers a vibrant coastal environment with mangroves, beaches, and cycling trails, while nearby landmarks include the Velodrome, Surf Abu Dhabi, and the High Performance Centre.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, tranquility, and investment potential, Hudayriyat Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of championship golf, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address makes it one of the emirate’s most desirable locations. This is a place where life finds its swing — grounded, boundless and effortlessly connected.
